prompt:

All objects separated by very generous fully transparent gutters (at least 10% cell size), absolutely no touching/overlap, NO drawn grid lines, NO labels or numbers. Blank cells fully empty. Objects are centered WITHIN their own cells with complete unobstructed silhouettes, furniture EMPTY and all tabletop objects separate. Exact layout:
Row 1, column 1: One EMPTY very wide low wooden checkout counter, long clean warm medium brown wood rectangular countertop with softly rounded edges, dark blue gray recessed front plinth, warm wood front trim. Entire countertop clear, no machine, register, cup, ice bin, tools, characters or side fixtures. Front orthographic elevated view, width:height5:1.
Row 1, column 2: One small standalone cream cash register with dark rectangular digital screen on short stand and compact cream base, matching cozy tea shop reference. No text, other devices, cups, table, coins or receipt.
Row 1, column 3: One standalone yellow lemonade DISPENSER matching reference front-left: rounded yellow top, clear front tank with lemons and pale lemon drink, small dark red lever tap low center, pale gray drip tray bottom, cream body sides. No glass display cabinet, no lettering, no table, no props. Complete appliance in orthographic elevated front view.
Row 2, column 1: One EMPTY small round warm brown wooden cafe table with thick elliptical round top, central wooden pedestal and round foot, orthographic slightly elevated frontal camera matching reference dining area. No chairs, drinks, cups, dishes, animals or tablecloth.
Row 2, column 2: One EMPTY wooden cafe chair from LEFT side of dining table in reference, facing inward to the RIGHT: backrest on left rear, rounded warm brown seat, curved slim dark brown wood back support and four short legs. Orthographic elevated camera matching reference, no animal, table, cup or cushion.
Row 2, column 3: One EMPTY wooden cafe chair from RIGHT side of dining table in reference, facing inward to the LEFT: backrest on right rear, rounded warm brown seat, curved slim dark brown wood back support and four short legs. Orthographic elevated camera matching reference, no animal, table, cup or cushion.
Row 3, column 1: One EMPTY low wide wooden beverage display table matching little front-left table in reference, rectangular warm wood top and short dark blue recessed plinth, soft rounded corners, width:height 3:1. No cups, labels or any objects.
Row 3, column 2: One small white glass milk bottle with pale gray cap, subtle cream tint, no label lettering. Ratio .61:1.
Style: follow provided tea shop reference faithfully but more refined, precise and clean. Soft warm hand-painted cartoon game illustration with rounded shapes, confident dark brown contour, warm honey medium wood, cream appliances, gentle upper-left highlights; consistent line thickness, lighting and same elevated frontal camera across EVERY object. Strict orthographic projection: parallel edges stay parallel, NO vanishing point, no perspective convergence, no isometric diamond orientation. Wooden tables have EMPTY plain tops, no baked on props; no characters, lettering, bubbles, other scene furniture, floor, tile patterns, checkerboard, vignette, glow or backgrounds. Real transparent RGBA background everywhere outside silhouettes and all gutters. Keep shading simple and edges crisp, not photorealistic. Use entire high resolution canvas efficiently while preserving transparent gutters. Only listed objects, complete independent sprites.
